facts.text: Guest Relations at Winton Center lists weekday hours of 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m., with named holiday closures including Thanksgiving and the following day. Its Saturday/holiday 9 a.m.–1 p.m. hours apply only from Memorial Day to Labor Day. Ranger Headquarters has separate hours; do not assume it offers Guest Relations services.
facts.quote: Guest Relations Mon. - Fri.: 8 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. Holidays & Saturdays, Memorial Day - Labor Day: 9 a.m. - 1 p.m. Closed: New Year's Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving, Day after Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas, New Year's Eve Ranger Headquarters Daily: 7 a.m. - 10 p.m.

facts.text: Great Parks describes the harbor launch as a floating dock with a transfer bench that slides onto a railing system to sit into a canoe or kayak. This is the operator’s equipment description; current operation, dimensions, transfer assistance and individual fit are not verified.
facts.quote: Each launch is a floating dock equipped with a “Universally Accessible Transfer System” that allows an unassisted individual with a physical disability to access a canoe or kayak. It consists of a bench that slides over onto a railing system that allows the individual to sit down into a canoe or kayak.

facts.text: The listed playgrounds, including Harper Meadows at Winton Woods, have a rubber surface, multiple wide ramps and shade structures according to Great Parks. The source does not give ramp slopes, clearances or a parking-to-play connection.
facts.quote: A rubber safety surface that allows access to all areas of the playground Multiple wide ramps for access with mobility devices
Shade structures for a more enjoyable play experience

facts.text: Great Parks describes bright colors and playable musical instruments at its listed playgrounds, including Harper Meadows. It does not identify a quiet session or give noise levels.
facts.quote: An array of bright colors to increase visual stimulation and playable musical instruments to increase auditory function

facts.text: Solo Rider golf carts are listed for Meadow Links & Golf Academy and The Mill Course. Call the individual course to reserve one or arrange a demonstration. The eight-cart figure is shared across several Great Parks courses, not a count available at Winton Woods.
facts.quote: Great Parks has eight Solo Rider golf carts available at the following golf courses: Meadow Links & Golf Academy, The Mill Course, Little Miami Golf Center, Miami Whitewater Forest Golf Course and The Vineyard Golf Course.
A Solo Rider cart can be reserved by calling the individual course. Players may also schedule a time for a demonstration of the cart

facts.text: The Harbor Loop page identifies two bridges and a connection to West Branch Trail through an underpass beneath Winton Road. It gives 801 Lakeview Drive as the trail address. Underpass slopes, clearances and current conditions are not specified.
facts.quote: Circling Winton Lake, the trail features two bridges and connects to the West Branch Trail via an underpass beneath Winton Road.

facts.text: Winton Center is described as a place to take a break from the adjacent trail, gather information, make reservations and buy a vehicle permit. The page lists restrooms but does not describe their access or changing features.
facts.quote: Inside the Winton Center, guests can gather park information, make reservations, purchase a Motor Vehicle Permit or take a break from the adjacent trail.
